meta.purpose: Observed outcomes. Keep separate from biological mechanisms.
meta.rule: One observed behavior is not an entire cause. Behavior is not FUNCTION, REGION, or ID.
meta.educational_source: Rita Carter et al., The Brain Book (DK, 2019) — The Infant Brain; Movement; Language; The Individual Brain
meta.disclaimer: These records are laboratory-style observations for the Ranvier language. They do not diagnose, score worth, or predict a life.

behaviors.notes: An action selected in a task. Insufficient as a causal model of decision_making.
A common developmental measure. A PATTERN of looking is not language identity.
Motor outcome. Related to movement FUNCTION only through a network model.
An audible outcome. Not the language NETWORK itself.
Observable orientation. Not attention as identity.
A state cycle. Temporary, measurable, not character.

patterns.notes: Repeated looking observations. May ground a PREDICTION, never an ID.
Repeated performance change. A trend is not destiny.
